items.label: ID Certificates
items.details: Minimum amount charged monthly to keep a certification active. This allows to generate advanced e-signatures tied to a user's wallet.

items.label: Sponsored transactions
items.details: Only the gas actually used is charged when sponsoring transactions, including relayer costs, processing fees and price fluctuations. Price is in Euro at currency rates updated every minute, with a minimum of 0.01€.

items.label: Advanced digital signatures
items.details: Advanced signatures for legally binding actions included in both Certified Solo and Certified Entity plans.

items.label: Certified storage (above 1GB)
items.details: Certified encrypted storage above 1GB is charged monthly for both organizations and personal workspaces.
